harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «تنزيل» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this Quran; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الرحمن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «تنزيل»; «الرحيم» is a naʿt.

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «كتاب» is a badal (substitute) from {تَنْزِيلٌ}; the clause «فُصِّلت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كتاب»; «قرآنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «آياته»; the preposition and its genitive noun «لقوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فصلت»; and the clause «يعلمون» is a naʿt of «قوم».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «بشيرا» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {قُرْآنًا}; the clause «فأعرض» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {فُصِّلَتْ}; and the clause «فهم لا يسمعون» is conjoined to the clause «فأعرض أكثرهم».

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «أكنَّة»; the clause «وفي آذاننا وقر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «قلوبنا في أكنة», and likewise the clause «ومن بيننا وبينك حجاب»; the clause «فاعمل» is conjoined to the clause «من بيننا وبينك حجاب»; and the clause «إننا عاملون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: «مثلكم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بشر»; the clause «يوحى» is a second naʿt of «بشر»; the interpreted maṣdar «أنما إلهكم إله واحد» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «فاستقيموا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قل»; the clause «وويل للمشركين» is resumptive, and beginning with an indefinite is permitted because it indicates an imprecation.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «الذين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المشركين»; the clause «وهم.. كافرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative clause «لا يؤتون»; the second «هم» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the first; the preposition and its genitive noun «بالآخرة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «لهم أجر» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن», and «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أجر».

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object of «تجعلون», and the clause «ذلك رب» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: The clause «وجعل» is resumptive; conjoining it to the clause {خَلَقَ} is weak because of the separation between them by something foreign, namely {وَتَجْعَلُونَ}. This «جعل» is transitive to one object, because it is in the sense of "created". The preposition and its genitive noun «من فوقها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رواسي»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في أربعة» is attached to «قدر». «سواء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied (muqaddar) governor, i.e.: they were equal; the preposition and its genitive noun «للسائلين» is attached to the implied governor.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ثم استوى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قدَّر»; the clause «وهي دخان» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «السماء»; «طوعا»: a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl; the clause «قالتا» is resumptive; and «طائعين» is a ḥāl of the pronoun «نا».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The clause «فقضاهنَّ» is resumptive; «سبع» is the second object of «قضاهنَّ», which carries the meaning of "made them into"; the preposition and its genitive noun «في يومين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «وأوحى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قضاهنَّ». His saying «وحفظا»: a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an implied (muqaddar) verb, i.e.: and We guarded it with a guarding; the clause "وحفظناها" is conjoined to the clause «زينَّا»; and the clause «ذلك تقدير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «فإن أعرضوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {قُلْ} in verse (9); «صاعقة» is a second object; «مثل» is a naʿt (adjective) of «صاعقة».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «إذ» is an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) {أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ}; the maṣdar «ألا تعبدوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (الباء); «أن» is the one that makes [the verb] accusative, and «لا» is prohibitive; the conditional clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); the clause «فإنا.. كافرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to «كافرون».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The clause «فأما عاد ...» is resumptive; «أما» is a particle of condition and detailing; the preposition and its genitive noun «بغير» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «استكبروا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «منا» is attached to «أشد»; «قوة» is tamyīz (specification); the clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive, and the interpreted maṣdar stands in place of the two objects of «يروا»; «هو أشد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «أن»; the clause «وكانوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قالوا»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بآياتنا» is attached to «يجحدون».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The clause «فأرسلنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَكَانُوا}; the preposition and its genitive noun «في أيام» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أرسلنا»; the maṣdar «لنذيقهم» is genitive, attached to «أرسلنا»; «عذاب» is a second object; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الحياة» is attached to «نذيقهم»; the clause «ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى» is parenthetical, the wāw is parenthetical, and the lām is of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); and the clause «وهم لا ينصرون» is conjoined to the clause «ولعذاب الآخرة أخزى».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «وأما ثمود فهديناهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {فَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوا}; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the clause «فهديناهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ثمود»; the clause «فاستحبوا العمى» is conjoined to the clause «هديناهم»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أخذتهم», and «ما» is a relative noun in the genitive by the bāʾ.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «ونجينا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أخذتهم».

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The wāw is resumptive; «يوم» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) "remember"; the preposition and its genitive noun «إلى النار» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يحشر»; and the clause «فهم يوزعون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يحشر».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya); «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the conditional clause is resumptive; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهد».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «وقالوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause. «لِمَ»: the lām is a preposition, and «ما» is an interrogative noun in the position of the genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «شهدتم»; its alif was dropped because it is preceded by the preposition. The clause «قالوا» is resumptive; the clause «وهو خلقكم» is conjoined to the clause «أنطقنا الله»; «أول» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), its adjective standing in for it; and the clause «ترجعون» is conjoined to the clause «خلقكم».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «وما كنتم تستترون» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar «أن يشهد» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e.: for fear [that ... should testify]; the clause «ولكن ظننتم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ما كنتم»; the interpreted maṣdar from «أنَّ» and what follows it stands in place of the two objects of «ظن»; the preposition and its genitive noun «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كثيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «وذلكم ظنكم ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَلَكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ}; «ظنكم» is a badal (substitute), and the relative noun is a naʿt (adjective); the preposition and its genitive noun «بربكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object, i.e.: you thought it to be concerning your Lord; the clause «أرداكم» is the khabar (predicate) of «ذلكم»; and the clause «فأصبحتم» is conjoined to the clause «أرداكم».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «فإن يصبروا» is resumptive, and «ما» operates like laysa.

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «وحق عليهم القول» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «زينوا»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في أمم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «عليهم»; the clause «قد خَلَتْ» is a naʿt (adjective) of «أمم». The preposition and its genitive noun «من الجن» is attached to a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «خلت»; and the clause «إنهم كانوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «وقال الذين» is resumptive; the clause «لعلكم تغلبون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «فلنذيقنَّ الذين» is resumptive; the clause «نذيقن» is the answer to the oath; «عذابا» is a second object, and likewise «أسوأ»; and the clause «لنجزينَّهم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «نذيقن».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: «النار» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «لهم دار الخلد», and the clause is resumptive. The preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «لهم»; «جزاء» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) whose governor is implied (muqaddar); the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to the maṣdar (جزاء); the preposition and its genitive noun «بآياتنا» is attached to «يجحدون».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «أَرِنا» is the answer to the vocative, resumptive; it is an imperative verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the omission of the weak letter, and the pronoun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «الذين» is a relative noun, a second object; the preposition and its genitive noun «من الجن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «أضلانا»; the clause «نجعلهما» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition; the adverb «تحت» is attached to the implied second object.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The clause «ثم استقاموا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قالوا»; the clause «تتنزل» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the maṣdar «ألا تخافوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (الباء), and «أن» is maṣdariyya, making [the verb] accusative; and the clause «وأَبْشِروا» is conjoined to the clause «لا تخافوا».

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «نحن أولياؤكم» is parenthetical; the preposition and its genitive noun «في الحياة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أولياء»; the clause «ولكم فيها ما تشتهي» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {كُنْتُمْ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «فيها» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar (predicate) is attached.

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «نزلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of {مَا}, i.e.: and you will have in it whatever you call for, it being prepared [for you]. The preposition and its genitive noun «من غفور» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an adjective of «نزلا».

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «ومَنْ أحسن» is resumptive; «قولا» is tamyīz (specification); the preposition and its genitive noun «ممن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أحسن»; «صالحا» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «عمل».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); the clause «فإذا الذي بينك وبينه عداوة» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «ادفع»; «الذي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the adverb «بينك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) placed before the mubtadaʾ «عداوة»; and the clause «كأنه ولي» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذي».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: The clause «وما يُلَقَّاها» is resumptive, and «الذين» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «يُلقَّاها».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The clause «وإما ينزغنَّك ...» is resumptive. «إما» is composed of the conditional «إن» and the redundant (zāʾida) «ما»; [«ينزغنك» is] an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the nūn, in the position of the jussive, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun «من الشيطان» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «نزغ»; «هو» is a tawkīd (emphasis) of the hāʾ in «إنه»; and «العليم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The clause «ومن آياته الليل ...» is resumptive; the clause «لا تسجدوا» is resumptive; the clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it; and «إياه» is a detached accusative pronoun, a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «تعبدون» placed first.

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The clause «فإن استكبروا» is resumptive; the clause «فالذين عند ...» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: then leave them; and the clause «وهم لا يسأمون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يسبِّحون».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The wāw is conjunctive; the interpreted maṣdar is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause (the seeing of the earth is among His signs) is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ اللَّيْلُ}; «خاشعة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the conditional clause is conjoined to the clause «ترى»; the clause «إن الذي أحياها ...» is resumptive; «الموتى» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun «على كل» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في آياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يلحدون»; the clause «أفمن يلقى..» is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «خير» is its khabar (predicate); the preposition and its genitive noun «في النار» is attached to «يلقى»; «أم» is the connected (muttaṣila) conjunctive one; «من» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the relative noun «من يلقى»; «آمنا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يأتي»; the clause «اعملوا» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «إنه بصير»; and the preposition and its genitive noun «بما» is attached to «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The clause «لما جاءهم» is parenthetical between the noun of «إن» and its implied (muqaddar) khabar (predicate), i.e.: are punished; and the clause «وإنه لكتاب عزيز» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause.

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «لا يأتيه» is a second naʿt (adjective); «تنزيل» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: it is a revelation; the preposition and its genitive noun «من حكيم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (verbal noun) «تنزيل».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The clause «ما يقال لك» is resumptive; «ما» is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition and its genitive noun «من قبلك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الرسل»; and the clause «إن ربك لذو» is a badal (substitute) from «ما».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «أأعجمي» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and likewise «عربي», the implied form being: is this Quran non-Arabic, while the tongue of the one to whom it was sent down is Arabic?! The clause «قل» is resumptive; «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «هدى»; the clause «والذين لا يؤمنون ...» is a mubtadaʾ, its khabar being the clause «في آذانهم وقر»; the preposition and its genitive noun «في آذانهم» is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «وقر»; the clause «وهو عليهم عمى» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the khabar clause; the preposition and its genitive noun «عليهم» is attached to a ḥāl of «عمى»; and the clause «أولئك ينادون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The wāw is resumptive, and the conditional clause is resumptive; the clause «سبقت» is a naʿt (adjective) of «كلمة», and the khabar (predicate) of «كلمة» is omitted; the preposition and its genitive noun «من ربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a second naʿt of «كلمة»; the clause «وإنهم لفي شك» is resumptive; and the preposition and its genitive noun «منه» is attached to a naʿt of «شك».

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «فلنفسه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the implied form being: his deed is for himself, and his evil-doing is against it. The clause «وما ربك بظلام» is resumptive, and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) in the khabar of «ما»; «للعبيد» is the object of «ظَلام», and the lām is redundant, for strengthening.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: His saying «وما»: the wāw is conjunctive, «ما» is negative, «من» is redundant (zāʾida), and «ثمرات» is the fāʿil (agent), and likewise «من أنثى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «بعلمه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تضع»; and the clause «وما تخرج من ثمرات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause «إليه يُرَدّ». The wāw in «ويوم» is resumptive, and «يوم» is an adverbial noun, the object of an implied (muqaddar) «اذكر» (remember); «أين» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of place attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «شركائي»; the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied saying, and this implied saying is a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: He calls them, saying: «أين شركائي». The clause «قالوا» is resumptive; «من شهيد» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant; the clause «ما منا من شهيد» stands in place of the second and third objects, because the verb here carries the meaning of «أَعْلَم» (to inform), even though the verb «آذن» is not one of the verbs transitive to three objects.

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: «ما» is a relative noun, the fāʿil (agent); the clause «وضلَّ عنهم ما كانوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the earlier clause {قَالُوا}; the clause «وظنوا» is conjoined to the clause «ضل»; the clause «ما لهم من محيص» stands in place of the two objects of «ظن»; «محيص» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «وإنْ مسَّه الشر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «لا يسأم»; «يؤوس» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: then he is despairing; and «قنوط» is a second khabar.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: The clause «ولئن أذقناه» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ}; the preposition and its genitive noun «منا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «رحمة»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من بعد» is attached to «أذقناه»; the clause {مَسَّهُ} is a naʿt of «ضراء»; the clause «ليقولن» is the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath; the clause «وما أظن» is conjoined to the clause «هذا لي»; the clause «ولئن رجعت» is conjoined to the clause «وما أظن»; the clause «إن لي عنده للحسنى» is the answer to the oath; the preposition and its genitive noun «لي» is attached to the khabar (predicate); the adverb «عنده» is attached to the [notion of] being-settled (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached; the clause «لننبئن» is the answer to the oath, and the oath together with its answer is a resumptive clause; and the clause «ولنذيقنَّهم» is conjoined to the clause «ننبئن».

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The conditional clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {لا يَسْأَمُ الإِنْسَانُ} in verse (49), and the second conditional clause is conjoined to the first. His saying «فذو»: the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: then he is possessed of.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: «أرأيتم» means "tell me"; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); it takes two objects: the first is omitted, its implied form being "yourselves", and its second object is the nominal clause «مَنْ أضل». The clause «إن كان من عند الله» is parenthetical, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what follows it, i.e.: then no one is further astray. The preposition and its genitive noun «ممَّن» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أضلّ».

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أنه الحق» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يتبين»; the clause «أولم يكف بربك» is resumptive; «بربك» is the fāʿil of «يكف», and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); and the interpreted maṣdar «أنه على كل شيء شهيد» is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «ربك».

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «من لقاء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مرية».
